basic_details.job_title: MSRLM CLF Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 11 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.age_details: Minimum 22 years to maximum 40 years (as on first date of the month in which the recruitment process is carried out)

qualification.education_qualification: Graduate in any discipline; minimum 3 years' experience as a community resource person under UMED; woman member of an UMED self-help group
qualification.details: Qualification: Graduate in any discipline; minimum 3 years' experience as a community resource person under UMED Experience: Minimum 3 years' experience as a community resource person under UMED (bookkeeper, VO/CLF accountant, community level auditor, Prerika, Vardhini, Bank Sakhi, Krishi Sakhi, BDSP, FL CRP etc.) Age limit: Minimum 22 years to maximum 40 years (as on first date of the month in which the recruitment process is carried out) | Other conditions: | Applicant must be a woman member of an UMED self-help group Must be a native resident of the prabhag for which she applies Command of the local language and able to read and write English and Hindi Her self-help group and village organisation must be in A or B grade Must be ready to travel to villages of the assigned prabhag for field work and attend training or workshops outside Should be a good communicator with leadership qualities, working sensitively on issues of poor families | Desirable: | Computer knowledge, with a computer training certificate attached Preference to members of deprived families, widows, deserted women, SC, ST, disabled, primitive tribes, SEBC and similar categories

salary_details.pay_scale: Honorarium Rs. 7200 per month plus Rs. 1500 travel allowance

how_to_apply: Obtain the application form at the CLF level, on www.zpsolapur.in or at the Taluka Mission Management Unit.
Attach a computer training certificate if claiming computer knowledge.
Submit the application to the Taluka Mission Manager, Taluka Mission Management Unit of the concerned taluka during office hours.
Submit between 20-11-2026 and 27-11-2026 till 6.00 PM; late applications will not be accepted.
important_instructions: Applications received after the deadline will not be accepted One CLF Manager is to be selected for each of the 11 model CLFs listed

content_sections.heading: MSRLM CLF Manager (Prabhagsangh Vyavasthapak) Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.maharashtra_state_rural_livelihoods_miss: Honorarium Rs. 7200 per month plus Rs. 1500 travel allowance
Graduate in any discipline; minimum 3 years' experience as a community resource person under UMED; woman member of an UMED self-help group
Minimum 22 years to maximum 40 years (as on first date of the month in which the recruitment process is carried out)
Taluka Mission Manager, Taluka Mission Management Unit, Barshi / Akkalkot / Madha / Mangalwedha / Sangola / Pandharpur

content_sections.heading: MSRLM Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. Solapur MSRLM/SIIB-CB 494/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download MSRLM notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Graduate in any discipline; minimum 3 years' experience as a community resource person under UMED Experience: Minimum 3 years' experience as a community resource person under UMED (bookkeeper, VO/CLF accountant, community level auditor, Prerika, Vardhini, Bank Sakhi, Krishi Sakhi, BDSP, FL CRP etc.) Age limit: Minimum 22 years to maximum 40 years (as on first date of the month in which the recruitment process is carried out) Other conditions: Applicant must be a woman member of an UMED self-help group Must be a native resident of the prabhag for which she applies Command of the local language and able to read and write English and Hindi Her self-help group and village organisation must be in A or B grade Must be ready to travel to villages of the assigned prabhag for field work and attend training or workshops outside Should be a good communicator with leadership qualities, working sensitively on issues of poor families Desirable: Computer knowledge, with a computer training certificate attached Preference to members of deprived families, widows, deserted women, SC, ST, disabled, primitive tribes, SEBC and similar categories

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for MSRLM Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Family members of CLF executive committee members (EC) or office bearers (OB) Members of local self-government bodies (PRI) Women working as Anganwadi Sevika, helper or ASHA worker Women serving in any government institution or NGO Women working as a local body member or office bearer

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: 11-month contract basis Post of a community-level institution, filled through the CLF

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MSRLM Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Obtain the application form at the CLF level, on www.zpsolapur.in or at the Taluka Mission Management Unit. Attach a computer training certificate if claiming computer knowledge. Submit the application to the Taluka Mission Manager, Taluka Mission Management Unit of the concerned taluka during office hours. Submit between 20-11-2026 and 27-11-2026 till 6.00 PM; late applications will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications received after the deadline will not be accepted One CLF Manager is to be selected for each of the 11 model CLFs listed

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MSRLM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MSRLM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 11 vacancies for CLF Manager (Prabhagsangh Vyavasthapak).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MSRLM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application form available at CLF level, on www.zpsolapur.in and at the Taluka Mission Management Units) and send it to Taluka Mission Manager, Taluka Mission Management Unit, Barshi / Akkalkot / Madha / Mangalwedha / Sangola / Pandharpur, by submit at the taluka mission management unit office during office hours, to reach by 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 22 years to maximum 40 years (as on first date of the month in which the recruitment process is carried out).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Honorarium Rs. 7200 per month plus Rs. 1500 travel allowance.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate in any discipline; minimum 3 years' experience as a community resource person under UMED; woman member of an UMED self-help group.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant must be a woman member of an UMED self-help group. Must be a native resident of the prabhag for which she applies. Command of the local language and able to read and write English and Hindi. Her self-help group and village organisation must be in A or B grade.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Family members of CLF executive committee members (EC) or office bearers (OB). Members of local self-government bodies (PRI). Women working as Anganwadi Sevika, helper or ASHA worker. Women serving in any government institution or NGO.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 11-month contract basis. Post of a community-level institution, filled through the CLF.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Akkalkot taluka, Solapur district.
